Strategy: Score favors bins whose leftover rounds to 20 when rounded to the nearest 10, so residuals near 20 outrank tighter or looser ones in coarse steps. It differs from Best Fit whenever the tightest leftover rounds to a different decade. It may help by quantizing residuals into reusable buckets, or fail because rounding discards real differences between close residuals.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-abs(round((r - item) / 10) * 10 - 20) for r in bins]
```
